xsync-filter(1) ​

Filters & mirroring

Select files and preview a mirror with explicit deletion behavior.

DESCRIPTION ​

Filters use first-match ordering. Include/exclude rules normally affect both the source list and deletion protection. Use quoted patterns so your shell does not expand them first.

EXCLUDE AND INCLUDE ​

Exclude generated and repository internals
sh
xsync -aP --exclude='node_modules/' --exclude='.git/' project/ backup/
Select text files while keeping directory traversal
sh
xsync -aP --include='*/' --include='*.txt' --exclude='*' src/ dst/

The directory include comes first so xsync can descend into directories that contain matching files. -m prunes empty directory chains from the filtered source list.

PREVIEW A MIRROR ​

Dry run — no writes or deletions
sh
xsync -ani --delete src/ dst/

Inspect the itemized plan and the would transfer …, delete … summary. When the plan matches your intent, execute the same source and destination with -n removed.

Execute with an explicit deletion limit
sh
xsync -aiP --delete --max-delete=100 src/ dst/
DELETION

--delete removes destination entries absent from the selected source tree. Source I/O errors suppress deletion unless --ignore-errors is explicitly requested. Exceeding --max-delete exits with code 25.

SOURCE AND RECEIVER RULES ​

RuleApplies to
H / SHide/show entries in the source list
P / RProtect/risk entries during destination deletion
+ / −Include/exclude; normally both sides
Protect a receiver-only directory
sh
xsync -aP --delete --filter='P local-notes/' src/ dst/

--delete-excluded makes unqualified include/exclude rules sender-only and allows excluded destination entries to be deleted. Explicit receiver protection still applies.

MERGE FILES ​

Load per-directory .rsync-filter files
sh
xsync -aP -F src/ dst/
Exclude filter files and defer deletion
sh
xsync -aP -FF --delete-after src/ dst/

A second -F excludes the merge files themselves. --delete-after reloads receiver rules from the updated tree after transfers finish, so newly transferred protection rules affect that deletion pass.

FILE LISTS ​

Copy selected directory trees recursively
sh
xsync -arP --files-from=selected.txt src/ dst/

Each list entry is relative to the source root. Leading slashes refer to that root; .. cannot escape it. Use -0/--from0 for filenames or patterns containing newlines.
